text:
sam_infra: Heads-up — trying to request an increase to 8 x A100s for project redwood-staging-01 in us-central1, but the GCP console refuses the quota request: 'Business verification required' and 'Payment method declined'. Need these for load testing on Wed. Anyone run into this?

jenna_billing: We're seeing the billing profile show VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Finance uploaded docs but portal still says pending. @matt_ops fyi — card attempts are getting flagged because Google wants a verified business profile. :thinking:

matt_ops: Short-term options: spin on our partner account, use a different region (e.g., europe-west1 allowed quota increases), or borrow from Dedicated pool. Latency/cost tradeoffs though.

sam_infra: I opened a support case (case 1234567890) — auto-reply said quota team can't process requests until verification completes, estimated 3-5 business days. Also tried CLI, got this response:
```bash
$ gcloud compute instances create test-gpu --project=redwood-staging-01 --zone=us-central1-a --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=8
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded. Details: Billing account verification required (PAYMENT_PROFILE_INVALID)
```

jenna_billing: Finance uploaded Articles of Incorporation and the W-9 yesterday; portal still shows pending. Submitted corrected billing address for the card (that was the mismatch). I'm going to escalate to our Google rep and open a billing escalation. Also try contacting Google Cloud Sales: https://cloud.google.com/contact — sometimes that speeds verification.

leah_prodsec: Quick compliance note: if we consider spinning up in europe-west1 as a workaround, don't run any EU customer data there until the contract addendum is signed. Use synthetic/test-only data.

stripe-bot: Payment failed on invoice INV-2026-03-05 for $12,400. Reason: card declined. Retry here: https://billing.redwood/Retry

matt_ops: Decision items: (1) Wait for verification (~3-5 biz days) (2) Use partner account for load tests (needs finance fronting) (3) Temporary region change with synthetic data. Jenna — can finance front partner account charges if Google estimate >48h? :pray:

jenna_billing: I'll ask finance to front the partner account charges and simultaneously escalate with Google partner support. If we can get an ETA >48h, we'll proceed with partner account. I'll post updates here. :+1:

sam_infra: Ok — I'll deprioritize GPU-heavy tests for tomorrow and run non-GPU validation. Tag me when finance confirms fronting. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
